title: President Kovind presents Shaurya Chakra to Paratrooper  Manchu
description: The President presented Shaurya Chakra to Paratrooper  Manchu, 12th Battalion, The Parachute Regiment (Special Forces). He displayed raw courage, presence of mind under heavy fire, initiative and determination of very high order and saved lives of his fellow squad members.   The President of India, Shri Ram Nath Kovind, presented Gallantry Awards and Distinguished Service Decorations at the Defence Investiture Ceremony held at Rashtrapati Bhavan on April 23, 2018. asr.full_text: Paratrooper Manchu of 12th battalion- The Parachute Regiment, Vizesh Bal On June 6, 2017, Naga Line had gotten any information about terrorist attacks To establish a mobile vehicle check post in Tejek area near Moon District, Nagaland Cooperation was carried out At around 10 pm two auto rickshaws overtook MVCP, and came on their way. They stopped suddenly on their way. Terrorists fell down, started heavy shooting and started to shoot granite. During this war, one officer, one officer and two other ranks soldiers were badly injured. Paratrooper Manjoo, though severely injured, kept moving forward among heavy firecrackers and two other ranked soldiers were seriously injured. Paratrooper Manchukhi became severely injured and was able to progress in the middle of a heavy firing.. ..and fight their second with a rifle.. ..and it succeeded to defeat three terrorists. Her eyes and shoulder were severely injured.. ..due to the grenade attack. She brought two of her gang members.. ..to safety, with no particular reason.. ..regarding the blood stream. Paratrooper Manchu made proud of his courage and determination while not caring about himself to the heart. While not caring about his serious wounds, he took an initiative and made his team of members happy. Paratrooper Manju.
